title: Why Jobs Put Gates on the Giant Screen
the_thought: He thought Bill copied the Mac and never had any taste.
hook: In nineteen eighty-three, Steve Jobs pulled Bill Gates into a room full of Apple people and said he was being stolen from.

levels.name: The Short
beats: Gates did not shout back. He said they both robbed a rich neighbor named Xerox. Jobs never bought that joke. Years later he said Microsoft had no taste, and that the copy was third-rate. Then he put Gates on a giant screen and took a hundred and fifty million dollars. He thought Bill copied the Mac and never had any taste.
